description: Standard test questions for spec 061 step 8 baseline calibration. These five questions exercise different deliberation shapes (binary tech-stack, build-vs-buy, adoption strategy, organisational topology, product timing). Drawn from the existing evals/promptfooconfig.yaml test bank for consistency.

questions.prompt: Should we use Postgres or MongoDB for our metadata store?
Are LLM-based code reviews ready to replace human reviewers?
How should a small team adopt formal verification for safety-critical code?
Is monorepo or polyrepo the right call for a 30-person engineering org?
Should we ship a public API in v1 or wait until our internal contracts stabilize?
